grade.reason: Ana and Ben both said yum to the Rainbow Chickpea Bowl, the most of any card. It's a quick 20-minute, no-cook meal. Cleo passed on it, but no other card got more support from the group.

results.title: A tie the mediator must break

grade.reason: Tied for most yums with 2 each. Dev and Eli both said yum, and they're the two who love Mexican food, so it's a fair middle ground. It's ready in 20 minutes with no cooking. Fay passed on it, so it's worth a quick check-in.

Neither of you said yum to any card this round, so nothing could win outright. Spaghetti Carbonara is a classic pasta that's quick at 20 minutes and an easy, familiar pick for both of you. Worth a try as a fair middle ground.

BBQ Chicken Pizza got the most yums (Pick the last card and Ivo), and nobody has a cuisine dislike or restriction that rules it out. It's a 35-minute crowd-pleaser, so it's the fairest option to cook together.
